methodology.sourceAuthority: DistroKid release dashboards are authoritative for distributed title, release/upload date, UPC, ISRC, delivery status, and store links.
methodology.titleMatching: Exact Unicode title equality is required for automatic Vault matches. Near matches remain manual review items.
methodology.scopeRule: Kirbai OS defaults to confirmed Pokémon projects. Unmatched releases remain needs_review rather than being assumed non-Pokémon.
methodology.identifierRule: UPC belongs to a release; ISRC belongs to a specific recording.

vaultPolicy.rule: Keep these releases in distribution history only. Do not create Vault projects for them unless Erik later changes this decision.
